rulings.reason: The instruction scores the presence of consumer call-to-action mechanics -- dates, prices, URLs 'for the public to act immediately' -- which is a genre marker of promotional product-launch copy rather than evidence that an independent journalist would find the item worth writing up. Concrete commitments do sometimes carry reportable substance, so the underlying specificity can co-produce genuine news value.

A judge scoring this would be rating register and authorial fingerprint -- informal phrasing, idiosyncratic asides, whether a principal rather than a PR department held the pen -- which is a tell about who produced the release, not about its news value. Founder-authored releases plausibly do carry more candid and substantive disclosure, so the upstream cause can produce genuine quality alongside the style signal.
